purpose: Derive task health independently from lifecycle so ACTIVE or COMPLETED tasks can identify lack of progress without inventing a new lifecycle state.

health_states.PROGRESSING: Observable canonical progress exists and an admissible continuation path is available.
health_states.WAITING: Progress is intentionally deferred by an explicit external/event/time/human condition with a named predicate or next-check condition.
health_states.BLOCKED: A canonical blocker or unsatisfied dependency prevents the next transition.
health_states.STALLED: No progress has been observed across the configured attempt/time threshold, but a recovery or continuation path still exists.
health_states.STUCK: The task is nonterminal but cannot derive an admissible next action and has no explicit wait/block condition explaining the lack of progress.
health_states.TERMINAL: Lifecycle is RETIRED, SUPERSEDED, or INVALID; no task execution continuation is permitted.
health_states.UNKNOWN: Available canonical evidence is insufficient to classify task health safely.
